pre_mia_hard_filter_basis: Official parser reports 571 pure spectra, 20 species, and 213 strains. Each species has 7 to 20 strains, allowing a species-preserving five-way strain allocation before outcomes are read.
outer_partition: Within each species, randomly allocate about 20% of strains to an external reference pool and divide all remaining strains between independent shadow and target pools. No strain is shared between the three pools.
membership_partition: For every shadow or target release, randomly divide strains within each species into member and nonmember groups. No strain is shared across membership labels.
transform: Median imputer and StandardScaler fit exclusively to the external reference pool; no target-pool information enters fitting.
release_3_label_encoding: Fixed public 20-species task vocabulary, so release feature widths are identical across group splits.
control: Matched-k KMeans fitted to exactly the member spectra of each corresponding GB release.
primary_contrast: GB minus matched-k KMeans at the same outer seed, target release, threshold, release level, and attack.
